llms.body:
# Devin

> Devin is an AI coding agent and software engineer built by Cognition. Engineering teams use parallel cloud agents to fix bugs, ship features, refactor code, and review PRs. Devin is available as a cloud service (app.devin.ai), a desktop app, a CLI, and a JetBrains plugin.

Indexable pages on devin.ai are also available as Markdown: request the page URL with `Accept: text/markdown`, or append `.md` to the path (for example https://devin.ai/pricing.md, or https://devin.ai/index.md for the homepage).

## Product

- [Devin homepage](https://devin.ai/): Overview of Devin, the AI software engineer
- [Contact Sales](https://devin.ai/contact): Get in touch with the Devin sales team
- [Devin Cloud](https://devin.ai/cloud): Parallel cloud coding agents
- [Devin Desktop](https://devin.ai/desktop): Manage local and cloud agents from one surface
- [Devin CLI](https://devin.ai/cli): Devin in your terminal
- [Download](https://devin.ai/download): Devin Desktop for Mac, Windows, and Linux, plus JetBrains plugin and CLI
- [Pricing](https://devin.ai/pricing): Free, Pro, Max, Teams, and Enterprise plans
- [Enterprise](https://devin.ai/enterprise): Enterprise-grade security, VPC deployment, and dedicated support

## Solutions

- [Devin for Security](https://devin.ai/security): Security engineering with exploit validation and remediation PRs
- [Financial services](https://devin.ai/financial-services): Devin for banks and financial institutions
- [Government](https://devin.ai/government): Devin for public sector engineering
- [Startups](https://devin.ai/startups): Devin for early-stage teams

## Resources

- [Blog](https://devin.ai/blog): Announcements, product updates, and research from Cognition
- [Customer stories](https://devin.ai/customers): Case studies from engineering teams using Devin
- [Documentation](https://docs.devin.ai/): Full product documentation, guides, and API reference
- [Docs llms.txt](https://docs.devin.ai/llms.txt): Machine-readable documentation index
- [Devin API OpenAPI spec](https://devin.ai/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Devin v3 REST API (YAML at https://devin.ai/openapi.yaml)
- [Devin MCP server](https://docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/devin-mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://mcp.devin.ai/mcp; server card at https://devin.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- [Security](https://devin.ai/security-program): Cognition security program and compliance

## Company

- [Cognition](https://cognition.com/): The applied AI lab behind Devin

	var PROD_APP_ORIGIN = "https://app.devin.ai";
	var LOCAL_APP_ORIGIN = "http://localhost:3000";
	var APP_ORIGIN_RULES = [{"apex":"itsdev.in","suffix":".itsdev.in","origin":"https://staging.itsdev.in"},{"apex":"devinenterprise.com","suffix":".devinenterprise.com","origin":"https://app.devinenterprise.com","privacyApiOrigin":"https://api.devinenterprise.com"}];

	function getDevinAppOrigin() {
		var h = window.location.hostname;
		for (var i = 0; i < APP_ORIGIN_RULES.length; i++) {
			var r = APP_ORIGIN_RULES[i];
			if (h === r.apex || h.endsWith(r.suffix)) return r.origin;
		}
		if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1') return LOCAL_APP_ORIGIN;
		return PROD_APP_ORIGIN;
	}
	window.getDevinAppOrigin = getDevinAppOrigin;

	var appOrigin = getDevinAppOrigin();
	if (appOrigin === PROD_APP_ORIGIN) return;

	var SELECTOR = 'a[href^="' + PROD_APP_ORIGIN + '"]';

	function rewrite(a) {
		if (!a || !a.getAttribute) return;
		var href = a.getAttribute('href');
		if (!href) return;
		if (href === PROD_APP_ORIGIN) {
			a.setAttribute('href', appOrigin);
		} else if (href.indexOf(PROD_APP_ORIGIN + '/') === 0) {
			a.setAttribute('href', appOrigin + href.slice(PROD_APP_ORIGIN.length));
		}
	}

	function rewriteWithin(root) {
		if (!root || root.nodeType !== 1) return;
		if (root.matches && root.matches(SELECTOR)) rewrite(root);
		if (root.querySelectorAll) {
			var as = root.querySelectorAll(SELECTOR);
			for (var i = 0; i < as.length; i++) rewrite(as[i]);
		}
	}

	function rewriteAll() {
		rewriteWithin(document.documentElement);
	}
	window.rewriteDevinAppLinks = rewriteAll;

	function startObserver() {
		if (typeof MutationObserver === 'undefined' || !document.documentElement) return;
		new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
			for (var i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
				var added = mutations[i].addedNodes;
				for (var j = 0; j < added.length; j++) rewriteWithin(added[j]);
			}
		}).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
	}

	function init() {
		rewriteAll();
		startObserver();
	}

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
	} else {
		init();
	}
})();

	var PRIVACY_API_ORIGIN_RULES = [{"apex":"devin.ai","suffix":".devin.ai","origin":"https://app.devin.ai"},{"apex":"itsdev.in","suffix":".itsdev.in","origin":"https://staging.itsdev.in"},{"apex":"devinenterprise.com","suffix":".devinenterprise.com","origin":"https://api.devinenterprise.com"}];
	var COOKIE_NAME = 'devin_privacy_optout';
	var LS_KEY = 'devin_privacy_optout';
	var LS_GPC_KEY = 'devin_gpc_first_seen';
	var LS_GPC_LOGGED_KEY = 'devin_gpc_logged';
	var LOCKOUT_MS = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

	function hasCookie() {
		return document.cookie.split(';').some(function (c) {
			return c.trim().indexOf(COOKIE_NAME + '=1') === 0;
		});
	}

	function hasLS() {
		try { return localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) === '1'; } catch (e) { return false; }
	}

	function gpcActive() {
		return navigator.globalPrivacyControl === true;
	}

	function gpcLocked() {
		try {
			var ts = localStorage.getItem(LS_GPC_KEY);
			if (!ts) return false;
			return (Date.now() - Number(ts)) < LOCKOUT_MS;
		} catch (e) { return false; }
	}

	window.__devinPrivacyOptedOut = hasCookie() || hasLS() || gpcActive() || gpcLocked();

	if (gpcActive()) {
		var logged = false;
		try {
			var existing = localStorage.getItem(LS_GPC_KEY);
			if (!existing || (Date.now() - Number(existing)) >= LOCKOUT_MS) {
				localStorage.setItem(LS_GPC_KEY, String(Date.now()));
			}
			localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, '1');
			logged = localStorage.getItem(LS_GPC_LOGGED_KEY) === '1';
		} catch (e) { /* localStorage unavailable */ }
		if (!logged) recordGpcOptOut();
	}

	// Mirrors privacyApiOriginForWebsiteHost(): unknown hosts (localhost,
	// previews) record nothing.
	function privacyApiOrigin(h) {
		for (var i = 0; i < PRIVACY_API_ORIGIN_RULES.length; i++) {
			var r = PRIVACY_API_ORIGIN_RULES[i];
			if (h === r.apex || h.endsWith(r.suffix)) return r.origin;
		}
		return null;
	}

	// Persist the GPC opt-out server-side (privacy_opt_outs, idempotent) once
	// per browser, on any page, so the record does not depend on the visitor
	// opening /privacy-choices. Best effort: the client id is set by the
	// first-party analytics beacon, so a brand-new visitor is recorded on a
	// later page view instead.
	function recordGpcOptOut() {
		var uuid = null;
		try { uuid = localStorage.getItem('devin_client_uuid'); } catch (e) {}
		if (!uuid) {
			var match = document.cookie.split('; ').filter(function (c) { return c.indexOf('devin_client_uuid=') === 0; })[0];
			if (match) uuid = match.split('=')[1];

		if (!uuid) return;
		var base = privacyApiOrigin(location.hostname);
		if (!base) return;
		try {
			fetch(base + '/api/privacy/opt-out', {
				method: 'POST',
				headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
				body: JSON.stringify({ client_uuid: uuid, opt_out_method: 'gpc' }),
				keepalive: true
			}).then(function (res) {
				if (res.ok) localStorage.setItem(LS_GPC_LOGGED_KEY, '1');
			}).catch(function () {});
		} catch (e) { /* best effort */ }
	}
})();
